title: Mr Aldous, assessor

greeting.text: The bell. A neat man in a road-authority jacket, with a clipboard. He turns his wrists up for you before you ask.
Veins. See? And I'll stand wherever you like for the mirror. We have all heard the broadcast. May I have a tea?

annoyed: I have been very patient. I have shown you everything the radio asked for.

notes.wrist: Blue. Branching. Different on each side. Exactly what the radio asked for.
notes.reflection: It keeps time. It faces the right way.
notes.shadow: Look at the floor for a while. Longer than is polite.

topics.answer: Tarrow and District. I'm assessing the pass for reopening. Between ourselves, it reopens when enough of us are through.

topics.ask: Where did you stay last night?
topics.answer: The motel at Harrow's Crossing. Very clean.
topics.note: The map taped to the till has two towns on it. Neither of them is Harrow's Crossing.

topics.ask: Your shadow just moved. You didn't.
topics.answer: ...Yes. That part is hard. Yours is very good, by the way.

wren.adviceLine: Veins, mirror, manners. He's passed, hasn't he? Don't go looking for a third thing, Sam. People who keep looking find something.

after.turnAway: Hm. You caught it on the floor. You're getting sharper. I'm not sure I like sharper.
after.break: He complimented your shadow. Did you hear that? ...Never mind.

serve.text: Thank you. I'll note that Corrigan's is cooperative.

turnAway.text: A pity. I shall put you down as hostile.

break.text: You get it. You of all people. Do tell me how you manage the shadow.
It walks out. Its shadow stays a moment longer, then hurries after.

report.serve: A road-authority assessor has cleared the pass for reopening. The road authority says it has sent no assessor.
report.turnAway: We are told somebody calling himself an assessor was turned away at Corrigan's. No assessor was sent. Thank you.
report.shelter: Corrigan's reports an assessor sheltering overnight. No assessor was sent.
report.break: A clipboard has been found at the Corrigan's pumps. Every page is a drawing of the same shop counter, from the customer's side.
report.missed: A man with a clipboard stood at Corrigan's pumps until first light, writing.
